gameDescriptionHtml:
Start with a clean slate and grow your grocery store from the ground up. Buy shelves, hire employees, expand your space, and manage your business your way—whether from behind the register, in the warehouse, or from the comfort of your office.

Game Features

  • PLAYSTYLE – Grocery Store Tycoon allows the user to play as the owner in first person view while also being able to manage the store from above with free camera movement.
  • CHECKOUT – Operate the cash register yourself if you would like to challenge the speed of your best cashier, or simply do not want to pay the wage. Swipe as fast as you can to avoid long queue times and unhappy customers.
  • STOCKING – Stock shelves by carrying a case at a time from the warehouse or use a cart to transport larger quantities.
  • CUSTOMIZABILITY – Purchase placeables such as cash registers, shelving, coolers, freezers, produce shelves, shopping cart corrals, shopping basket stands, material handling equipment, and decorations.
  • INTERACTIVE UI – Interactive UI to manage your store through customer statistics, supply and demand of goods, pricing adjustments, placeable condition viewing, and employee management.
  • PROGRESS – Unlock item types, placeables, management tools, employee hiring capacity, store expansions, and the opportunity to purchase other stores by gaining experience passively, by working, or by completing bonus objectives.
  • MAINTENANCE – Maintain placeables, return carts and baskets, and keep the store clean to keep your store operating at its full potential.
  • EMPLOYEE MANAGEMENT – Manage employees to keep them happy or they may quit! Assigning an employee to the job they would like, the wage they want, and not overworking them all contribute to the employee’s happiness. Unreliable employees may call in and affect your happiness.
  • CUSTOMER SATISFACTION – Customers must be satisfied to get good reviews and keep your store in good standing. Having the goods they seek, keeping them in the store for as little time as possible, and having a charismatic employee behind the cash register all contribute to the satisfaction of customers.
